newsitem.title: USA: IPO HIGHLIGHTS - Colonial Downs shrs slip.
newsitem.headline: IPO HIGHLIGHTS - Colonial Downs shrs slip.

text.p: Shares of Colonial Downs Holdings Inc broke issue, or slipped below their initial public offering price, in late afternoon trading, falling 1/8 to 9-3/8 after opening with a $0.50 premium at $10 a share.
The 4.25 million shares priced at $9.50 a share, within the estimated range of $9 to $11. The range had earlier been revised upward from $8 to $10 a share.
The deal had been expected to make its debut last week.
The Providence Forge, Va.- based company was formed to pursue the business of horse racing and "pari-mutuel" wagering in Virginia.

The company said in its filing the proceeds of the offering would be used toward completing the construction of a race track, harnessing satellite wagering facilities, repaying financing acquired from certain shareholders, and for other corporate purposes.
Friedman, Billings, Ramsey & Co was lead underwriter on the deal.
